widgets_values:
Minimax H3 "10 second visual blockbuster (fashion MV+extreme parkour)
Role: Minimax H3 (short black hair, Korean style trendy beauty, wearing a black pink contrasting waist revealing short jacket and spicy work pants).
Sound effects: heavy bass Synth Pop, wind sound, glass shattering sound, laser cutting sound.
Shot 1 (1s | Close up): A bright pink background, Minimax H3 with short black hair and sunglasses looking sideways at the camera, with yellow 3D characters "H3" flashing behind.
Sound effect: Clear electronic prelude.
Camera 2 (1s | Parkour): Crash Zoom, Minimax H3 sprints and parkour at high speed on the colorful rooftop, with short hair flying and dragging colorful shadows.
Sound effects: The sound of stepping on the ground and the gust of wind.
Camera 3 (1s | Jump): Low angle overhead shot, Minimax H3 jumps high at the edge of the rooftop, and flips 360 degrees in the air.
Sound effect: Music instantly takes a break (Filter effect).
Shot 4 (1s | Layout): Extreme slow motion, with huge white bold letters "FLY" shuttling past her, creating a poster layout sense.
Sound effect: ethereal whistling sound.
Camera 5 (1s | Fight): Minimax H3's gaze suddenly changes in mid air, and he unleashes a heavy punch wrapped in electric particles.
Sound effect: Energy charging and sizzling sound.
Camera 6 (1s | Broken Screen): [Core Explosion] Fist hits the camera, the punch blows the screen, and fluorescent glass fragments burst and splash.
Sound effect: Extremely crisp glass shattering sound+Bass Drop.
Camera 7 (1s | Landing): Passing through fragments (transition), Minimax H3 lands on the ground with one hand and rolls forward, splashing colored smoke.
Sound effect: Heavy landing sound.
Camera 8 (1s | Weapon): Minimax H3 stands up and pulls out a pink laser nunchucks, playing dazzling light trail shadows in front of him.
Sound effect: Laser cutting air sound.
Shot 9 (1s | freeze frame): Quick push close-up, Minimax H3 retracts the nunchucks to the armpits, hands against sunglasses blink and smile sweetly at the camera, and the background is filled with the words "DANCE".
Sound effect: The music reaches its climax with a loud freeze.
Camera 10 (1s | Closing): Minimax H3 gracefully turns around and steps into a minimalist pink background, with the Minimax H3 brand logo popping up in the center.
Sound effects: Key sound effects, clean and crisp pauses.
